name: gas_turbine_reduced_quantities
title: Gas turbine regime linked by reduced flow and reduced speed
summary: Steady exercise of a single-shaft gas turbine burning methane in air: one regime at 50000 rpm is tied to the nominal reduced mass flow and reduced speed by a proportionality on the compressor and a single expander characteristic.

origin.course: ULiège MSTh, machines et systèmes thermiques, repetition R9 exercise 1

verification.summary: Stored solution of MSTH-SB-R9-EX1.EES. compare_solution.py: 50 common variables, 19 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 0; only in CoolSolve: 8. Reduced flow and speed agree. Shaft power 2.652 MW versus 2.728 MW (2.78% low); efficiency 0.2957 versus 0.3014 (1.92% low). h_1 is +125.9 kJ/kg above EES; s_1 is the largest relative difference (0.320).
verification.reference: EES stored solution of MSTH-SB-R9-EX1.EES (50 values, EES X7.458)
verification.notes: Maximum relative difference is s_1 (entropy reference of Air: 3849.95 versus 5664.81 J/kg-K). h_1 is a separate enthalpy reference offset of +125873 J/kg at the same 15 °C. Shaft power and efficiency differ because the compressor work and the methane specific heat do not share that constant. MR_c, MR_e and NR agree to 1e-10. The eight CoolSolve-only names are unused outputs of the two cpbar CALLs.
